description:
Owner decision 2026-11-12 (choice dialog): close Theseus #74 and keep `protocol.pre_existing: block` everywhere. Reason: over 15 hosted rounds each verdict found a new way a change can trigger an unchanged defect without a file-level scan noticing (data/config files, new calls through existing imports, symlinks, depth-limited import walks, C/Java definitions, packaged prompt templates). Any scan strict enough to satisfy the reviewer demotes almost nothing, so it adds nothing over `block`.
Also by owner decision: no base-branch reproduction design now, no one-click adjudication feature, no known-issues store. The known-defects items are parked with a reopen trigger instead.
Steps:
1. Close #74 with a two-sentence comment giving the reason above (no session labels, no item ids).
2. Remove worktrees theseus.wt-known and theseus.wt-guidance with `git worktree remove` after confirming each is clean and its branch is merged or pushed. Never use --force.
3. Set theseus-known-defects-pre-existing-20261109 and theseus-known-defect-base-reproduction-proof-20261109 to blocked, with the reopen trigger in context: each time the owner adjudicates a finding only because it was pre-existing, append a note to theseus-known-defects-pre-existing-20261109; three such notes reopen the design question.
Decision gate: none left; any proposal to revive a static trigger scan needs a new owner decision.
Guardrails: no change to any policy file; pre_existing stays block; no owner-only actions; no tracker drop of the parked items (they stay as blocked records).
